q: Which of the following is NOT correct about the final bill?

options.A: It is based on final measurements
options.C: It can be submitted before completion of work

q: What is the effect of payment of the final bill?

options.A: It starts a new round of claims
options.C: It generally settles all claims under the contract

q: Before passing the final bill, the Railway:

options.B: Verifies measurements and admissibility of claims

q: Release of the security deposit is generally linked to:

options.C: Successful completion and settlement of the final bill

q: Deductions in the final bill may include:

options.C: Recoveries for advances, defective work, taxes and other dues

q: After receiving final payment, the contractor raises a new claim for an old item. Generally:

options.A: It is entertained as of right
options.D: It is barred, having not been included in the final bill

q: Which of the following is correct about the final bill?

options.A: The final bill needs no supporting measurements
options.B: The final bill is prepared from final measurements and verified
options.C: The contractor cannot sign the final bill

q: Before payment, the final bill is normally:

options.B: A prerequisite for processing the final bill

q: During the maintenance or defect liability period:

options.A: Some amount may be retained till its expiry as per terms
